Scene:
古代的时候，一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子。他们住在墓地的旁边，所以孟子老是祭拜。孟子不是祭拜，就是跟朋友聊天。他很喜欢他的城市，但是城市有才两个学校，都很小。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 但是城市有才两个学校：这个城市，只有

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 城市有才两个学校：城市才有两个学校，才 must come before the verb 有 to limit the number of schools. [rule: none]
Run 2: 有才两个学校：只有两个学校，use “只有” to express that the city has only two schools; “有才” does not form this limited-quantity pattern. [teacher rule: zhiyou_caiyou]
Run 3: 城市有才两个学校：城市里才有两个学校，In an existential sentence, the limiting adverb must come before the verb, so use the order “才有”; “城里” gives the location naturally. [rule: none]

output.reason: All runs address the misplaced limiting adverb in “有才两个学校” and give acceptable ways to express that the city has only two schools.
